headlines.title: DNC committee sets up South Carolina to vote first in Democrats’ 2028 presidential primaries
headlines.description: South Carolina is poised to hold the first Democratic presidential nominating contest in 2028 after the Democratic National Committee’s powerful rules committee voted to keep the state at the front of the line.

headlines.title: White House Correspondents’ Dinner Returns Under High Security
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is gearing up to attend the rescheduled White House Correspondents Dinner Friday night, after the initial event back in April was targeted by a gunman. The Secret Service says it’s confident in the security plan for the dinner while also acknowledging an alarming rise in threats. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Vows Retaliation Against Iran for Houthi Attack in Red Sea
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is vowing retaliation against Iran, saying he is considering a “massive attack” after Houthi rebels struck two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea. The attack pushed international oil prices above $100 a barrel for the first time since May. NBC’s Richard Engel reports and Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker joins TODAY with political analysis.

headlines.title: Oil price surge as war with Iran expands
headlines.description: International oil prices pushed past $100 a barrel today as markets reacted to a new threat by the Houthis in Yemen against ships in the Red Sea. NBC News’ Chief Foreign Correspondent Richard Engel reports.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump to deliver ‘unifying yet vicious’ remarks at Correspondents’ dinner, White House says
headlines.description: The White House Correspondents’ Association Dinner with President Donald Trump that was disrupted earlier this year when a gunman charged past Secret Service agents is scheduled to be reheld in a different, smaller and more secure venue Friday night.

headlines.title: Fresh wave of U.S. tariffs takes effect, hitting global trade partners
headlines.description: These new duties, which range from 10% to 12.5%, will take effect Friday morning, just as the previous tariffs expire.

headlines.title: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul explains why she signed the first statewide moratorium on data centers
headlines.description: Speaking with NBC News’ “Here’s the Scoop,” Hochul said that she’s responding to the concerns of localities and that New York doesn’t need data centers to support the AI boom.

headlines.title: DOJ agrees to withdraw subpoenas of New York Times journalists over Air Force One reporting
headlines.description: A judge repeatedly questioned why prosecutors had issued the subpoenas before pursuing alternative investigative steps.

headlines.title: Oil prices surge as Congress splits on Iran war votes: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we examine how the escalating Iran war is playing out in the oil markets and the halls of the Capitol. Plus, Scott Wong and Matt Dixon have a profile of the little-known new senator from South Carolina.

headlines.title: Rep. Jim Jordan formally asks DOJ to prosecute Jack Smith over congressional testimony
headlines.description: Jordan, chair of the House Judiciary Committee, accused Smith of lying in his testimony before the committee in December. Smith’s lawyers denied he made any false statements.
